+import warnings

+def test_pydantic_v1_warning_once():
+    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
+        warnings.simplefilter("always")
+        
+        class ItemV1(BaseModel):
+            name: str
+            price: float
+
+        class OtherItemV1(BaseModel):
+            name: str
+
+        app = FastAPI()
+
+        @app.get("/1")
+        def read_item1(item: ItemV1):
+            return item
+
+        @app.get("/2")
+        def read_item2(item: OtherItemV1):
+            return item
+
+        v1_warnings = [
+            warn for warn in w 
+            if issubclass(warn.category, DeprecationWarning) and "Pydantic v1" in str(warn.message)
+        ]
+        
+        assert len(v1_warnings) == 1, f"Expected exactly 1 DeprecationWarning, got {len(v1_warnings)}"
+        print(f"Caught {len(v1_warnings)} warning(s)")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        test_pydantic_v1_warning_once()
+        print("Check passed!")
+    except AssertionError as e:
+        print(f"Check failed: {e}")
+        exit(1)
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"An error occurred: {e}")
+        exit(1)
